digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model class resolution
propositions: The single REBAR_LLM_MODEL scalar cannot express per-tier model mappings, causing silent downgrade failures when non-default providers are used
Current inference logic in verify.py:269 and completion.py:332 silently stops applying model downgrades for non-Anthropic-default models via equality tests against framework default
Plan-review Pass-1 ladder bare names route to direct Anthropic regardless of configured provider, creating split-brain cross-provider execution
Three reserved class names (trivial, standard, frontier) must be resolvable through three distinct call sites: config.resolve_model, batch runner model_ladder expansion, and verifier paths
Config layering must deep-merge table fields while replacing arrays wholesale, preserving sibling keys when only one field is overridden in REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE
